title: To award the Congressional Gold Medal to Shimon Peres.
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was passed by the House on May 19, 2014. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Directs the Speaker of the House of Representatives and the President pro tempore of the Senate to arrange for the presentation of a congressional gold medal in honor of President Shimon Peres of Israel.

summary.headline: A 2014 law directs Congress to award a Congressional Gold Medal to Shimon Peres, the former Israeli president.
summary.what_it_does: The law tells the Speaker of the House and the President pro tempore of the Senate to arrange a presentation of a Congressional Gold Medal honoring Shimon Peres. The medal is a symbolic honor given by Congress. The summary does not describe any money, rules, or services beyond arranging the presentation.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on June 9, 2014.
